description: I’m Charles—an AI & Data Science undergraduate building intelligent applications, full-stack experiences, and more secure software.
about: I’m Undela Charles Abhishek Reddy, an AI & Data Science undergraduate at Jansons Institute of Technology. My hands-on experience spans software development, AI/ML, full-stack web applications, enterprise platforms, and cybersecurity. From diagnosing plant diseases with computer vision to exploring network threats, I enjoy turning technical ideas into useful applications. I’ve worked across design, development, testing, debugging, and automation through internships and project-based learning.

projects.title: Aerovanta
projects.description:
An AI-driven platform for image-based plant disease detection, infection assessment, and personalized treatment recommendations. Integrates AI chatbot assistance, crop timelines, activity logging, treatment scheduling, notifications, and historical farm records.

Technologies: TensorFlow, Computer Vision, AI.

projects.title: Autonomous Delivery Route Planner
projects.description:
An adaptive route-planning system for dynamic environments with real-time obstacle handling. Implements A* and D* algorithms for optimal pathfinding and intelligent rerouting under changing conditions.

Technologies: Python, A*, D* algorithms.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Secure Code Review
projects.description:
A static-analysis platform to detect insecure APIs, exposed credentials, and input-validation vulnerabilities. Implements severity scoring, line-level vulnerability mapping, and contextual remediation recommendations. Achieved 4th place among 60 teams in a national cybersecurity hackathon.

Technologies: Python, full-stack development, OWASP Top 10.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Task Management
projects.description: A production-ready multi-tenant task management platform with secure organization-level data isolation and JWT-based authentication. Implements Admin/Member role-based access control, task assignment workflows, and refresh-token authentication. Includes audit logging and a responsive React dashboard for task lifecycle management, user administration, and activity traceability across organizations.

experience.title: Full Stack Web Development Intern
experience.details: Developed 4+ responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implemented DOM manipulation, event handling, dynamic content updates, and client-side form validation. Applied responsive design, testing, debugging, and cross-browser compatibility practices.

experience.title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Intern
experience.details: Conducted web application and network security assessments using Kali Linux, Nmap, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, and Metasploit. Performed reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, OWASP Top 10 testing, risk analysis, and remediation reporting. Participated in penetration-testing and red-team simulation exercises following ethical hacking methodologies.

Engineered an immersive VR platform that reduced client onboarding demonstration time by 30%. Contributed across application design, prototyping, development, optimization, and deployment, supporting CRM-driven architecture and automation.

Applied machine-learning techniques to support network threat detection and classification. Strengthened practical skills in AI/ML, cybersecurity, data analysis, and intelligent system development.
